name: Fujimidai
tagline: Shinjuku in 29 minutes and Shibuya in 34 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nakano City, where Seibu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 40 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 55 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 43.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 43.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 35.9 m to 44.8 m, a difference of 8.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 4 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 10 clinics and 11 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 秀佑会東海病院, about 20 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 忠医会病院, about 23 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Seibu Ikebukuro Line.
congestion: Seibu Ikebukuro Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 椎名町→池袋, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. quiet surroundings pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Nakamurabashi; for quiet, Fujimidai.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Fujimidai. It is served by the same lines as Fujimidai. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥5,000 less at Nakamurabashi. On the number of medical facilities, Nakamurabashi comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how little of the area is in the flood projection, Nerima-Takanodai; for how close the centre is, Fujimidai.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Fujimidai in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Fujimidai. To Tokyo, for instance, Nerima-Takanodai takes 3 minutes longer. On what it offers families, Nerima-Takanodai comes out ahead.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Seibu Ikebukuro Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
